name: tabs
title: Tabs and segmented control
description: A tinted track with the active tab raised on the card surface. The same look serves page tabs (switch panels) and segmented controls (switch a view or a filter).
whenToUse: Tabs switch between panels of one page. A segmented control switches a view of the same data (Monthly / Quarterly). Up to about 6 options; the track scrolls sideways if it runs out of room.

variants.description: Tab list; panels are tx-tab-panel elements. Behaviour from twinx.js (data-tx-tabs).
Same look, for radio-like view switches.
Underline style for tabs inside a card head.
Small count after a tab label.

a11y: role="tablist" / "tab" / "tabpanel" with aria-selected and aria-controls. twinx.js adds arrow-key navigation. A segmented control uses aria-pressed on its buttons.
